summary: This implementation plan details the architecture and step-by-step implementation for a robust CEISA document scanning and restructuring pipeline. It features an image preprocessing module (handling deskewing, rotation, and unwarping using OpenCV and PaddleOCR), a structural OCR extraction module using Docling to capture dense multi-column layouts and tables, and a semantic restructuring module using LLMs (Ollama/OpenAI) with enforced JSON schemas to produce output conforming to standard CEISA forms.
